changes.comment: BREAKING: JsonSchema.fromJson resolves local $ref (#/$defs/…, #/definitions/…, any #/… pointer) by inlining, bounded at 32 nested and 1000 total expansions; toJson() emits the inlined, reference-free schema. Remote refs, anchors, recursive schemas, refs beside validation keywords and refs under a nested $id are refused with the keyword and path named. $dynamicRef and $recursiveRef, previously ignored, are now refused.
